verdict.rationale: Pydantic Evals is a first-party, code-first evaluation framework. It grades agent final outputs and tool-call trajectories against datasets, and LLM-as-a-judge scoring records the judge's reasoning, so the scoring half is well documented. Running evals in CI is only implied by the code-first design and 'run the suite from your code'; no doc describes CI integration, pass/fail gating or exit codes. missing for 10: explicit CI integration/gating documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of evals in CI pipelines

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI

citations.quote: Pydantic Evals is a powerful evaluation framework for systematically testing and evaluating AI systems, from simple LLM calls to complex multi-agent applications.
It grades an agent's final outputs and its trajectory (the sequence and arguments of its tool calls), against datasets in code
Pydantic Evals follows a code-first philosophy where all evaluation components are defined in Python.
run the suite from your code, and compare a candidate with a baseline case by case
